project.name: Localhost Foglamp Viewer
project.tagline: How localhost serves foglamp's map with your data — nothing uploaded

nodes.label: Your browser
nodes.detail: Opens the map and runs foglamp's renderer locally; the graph hydrates from data embedded in the page.

nodes.label: serve.py proxy
nodes.detail: A tiny local server that serves the built page and reverse-proxies renderer asset requests. Nothing runs on foglamp's servers.

nodes.label: Route matcher
nodes.detail: Serves the page at foglamp's ORIGINAL route path so Next.js hydration matches — a mismatched path blanks the page.

nodes.label: Privacy allow-list
nodes.detail: Forwards only /_next asset GETs to foglamp; blocks favicons (/api), analytics (/_vercel), the RSC prefetch and every POST. Logged to serve.log.

nodes.label: build.py
nodes.detail: Build step: swaps the scan JSON into the shell's data payload and injects the privacy guard script.

nodes.label: Foglamp shell
nodes.detail: foglamp's server-rendered /scan page — the empty renderer container, downloaded a single time.

nodes.label: Scan JSON
nodes.detail: The architecture map data. Read at build time and embedded inline — it never leaves the machine.

nodes.label: Built page
nodes.detail: Foglamp shell + inline scan data; only ever served from localhost.

nodes.label: Foglamp CDN
nodes.detail: Serves the public Next.js + Turbopack renderer bundle — identical for every visitor, carrying none of your data.
